s: Pabi and Boo want to eat a rainbow. Can they find one?
All Jabu wants to do is play diketo. But everyone is busy. What is he going to do?
I love my hat. But who ate my hat?
Two sisters, one window seat, and a magical train ride!
When Khaya sees rowers on TV, he starts dreaming of being a rower one day. Mkhulu plans a special surprise – what will it be?
I love being with Mom. Her beautiful hands dance and form signs. I watch and I learn. South African Sign Language is Mom’s language and now it is my language too.
Banzi loves to garden with Gogo. Most of all, he loves bees. But one day, all the bees and flowers are gone! How will Banzi get them back?
Mfubu and his friends have a problem – their pool is dirty. They go on an adventure up the river to find out why.
The children in Ms Kani’s class had a busy weekend. Where will they go next?
Zindzi and Tim Tam are best friends. But one day, Tim Tam doesn’t come to school. What will Zindzi do?
Chop! Shake! Fold! Amir’s samoosas aren’t perfect triangles, but Grandma knows: different can be delicious.
Tissues belong in the bin. But will Thuli ever get it in?
Do you nibble or munch or gulp? Miri crunches her toast, but she wants to know how other creatures eat.
Susu LOVES reading. She is so excited to have her own book! But EVERYONE wants to read it … even a dragon!
Mr Owl is ashamed to come out during the day. Why does Mr Owl only show his face at night when all the other animals are sleeping?
There are so many books in the world! Julia loves to read them all. But one very special book is missing. What will Julia do?
Tshedza is a little boy with a big imagination. Sometimes Tshedza gets scared, but maybe the world is not as scary as it seems?
Dali can’t wait for Tata to come home for the weekend. What will they do when he arrives?
One day, Fafa woke up with Grumpy Cloud. Mama and Fafa tried to make Grumpy Cloud go away.
Mazi wants to play dodgeball with his older brother and sister, but first, he must learn the rules!
Oyisa loves fruit, but she never knew seeds could be so magical! When a seed grows into a giant tree, she finds herself high above the ground. What surprises will she uncover?
Thembeka hates winter. She wishes it was warm and sunny. Can she find something to love about winter?
Jock the dog is our good, old friend. Come have fun with us!
Khanyiswa is not the first born. She’s not the last born. She’s the one in the MIDDLE!
There’s a monster in our house. It’s noisy, messy and smelly. And it’s time for the monster to GO!
Ouma has amazing flowers! Robyn wants to pick them all …
When Olwethu opens a magical door she is taken on an adventure.

t: Let’s go on a litter hunt
s: The yard is a mess. How will the children clean up?
Zingisile’s birthday falls on a school day this year. How will he celebrate?

t: How do you want your eggs?
s: Boiled, scrambled or fried? How does Luzuko want his eggs?
Oluhle fetches water at the tap every day. She gets to carry her favourite pink bucket. But one day it gets lost …
In the wild, every day is a busy day – especially for monkeys. What keeps them so busy?
I could go as a superhero. I could go as a bunny – or a birthday cake! I have so many ideas … How will I decide?
Amahle wants to help, but all she hears is “NO”. Is there anything she’ll be allowed to do?
Things get messy when Zama’s new friend gets her into trouble with Mama. How can she make it stop?
Khuzwayo loves to dance. But performing in front of a crowd? No way! How will he get his groove back?
Tayo’s baby sister Tinu is always crying and he doesn’t know why. What could it mean? Let’s find out!
Thembi and Thulani are sad. They miss Grandpa Nathi. Daddy and Mommy find a special way to remember Grandpa Nathi.
Lebo is excited to have a day of adventure with Gogo. When Gogo hurts herself, she can’t do anything that Lebo wants to do. What can Gogo and Lebo do to have fun together?
Thembsie really wants a dog, but she can’t have one. So Thembsie comes up with a plan of her own.
Mom needs to go away for work. I’ll miss her. Will it help if she leaves her red coat with me?
Luthando is very good at listening and very good at smelling, but he’s not so good at looking where he is going. He walks into puddles and bumps his head. What could be the problem?
During heavy rains, a little kindness can go a long way. Join Zenande as she comes together with her community.
Jabulani has lost his school shoe. He can’t find it anywhere. Where can it be?
Fifi has a brown teddy bear that she loves very much. But where is Teddy?
Matthew wakes up with the sun. But he is the only one!
Oh no! A sneaky cat has stolen my sock. Come with me and my dog to help us catch that cat!
Zibu and Zizo are twin brothers. They are similar, but different. Being different is not bad, it’s great.
Once the school bell rings, the excitement begins. Grandpa picks Fatima up from school. What adventures will they have?
Dad comes home with a box. Boring. Until Max and Andi’s friends come to play… What will they do with the box?
Alex needs a plan. He doesn’t like medicine, but he wants to feel better. What will he do with the bottle of green medicine?
What treasures did Sam find in the park?
Making friends isn’t always easy. But let’s try!
Joanna has two grannies. They are very different but they both love her the same.
Everyone can make music! Just say: Boom! Tikky! Wubba! Tish!
Can you sleep with one eye open? Can you sleep in a tree? Pula has a bed, but he wants to know how other creatures sleep.
Bonke and Peo don’t know what’s at the top of their favourite hill. What will they find if they’re brave enough to climb it?
Look up! There’s so much to see.
Going to the doctor can be scary! Can Bora overcome his fears, with a little help from Baba and Jojo?
Two birds go on a quest to find the best nest ever.
Join Thabo and his sister Tumi for magical lunches with Mama!
Fezile rummages under the bed to help Gogo find her shoes. He finds many others instead. Who do all these shoes belong to? And where do they carry the people who wear them?

t: The boy who only ate pancakes
s: Rekai only loves to eat pancakes, so Mom finds a way to make them even better!
Jibraan explores his many talents and gifts. He loves learning new skills. But what’s the Best Gift of all?
When Pako the Pigeon goes missing, Namwayi and Dairine can’t fi nd her in the garden or the sky. But Cat saves the day.
Shaka has a special friend that nobody else can see. Now Shaka and his family have to move away. Can he make room for new friendship?
Join Teacher Langa’s class as they share what they want to be when they grow up. Let’s see what they say!

t: There’s a Fire on the Mountain
s: Thuli and her friends love to play “There’s a Fire on the Mountain”. But then one day there is a real fire and all the beautiful plants on the mountain are turned to ash. Thuli and her friends are sad … until they see some tiny red and green shoots. What could they be?
Layo can’t wait to grow. But just like the bamboo seeds he and grandma plant, it might take a little longer than he wants!
Tlotlego is hosting a tea party! But something strange keeps happening while he is setting the table.
When Lwando’s little sister gets mad, she turns into a monster. Can Lwando help her tame her big feelings?
It’s so hot! Lilato and Mayamiko are bored. Ndo-ndo! But what is that sound?
Yapo loves to play soccer! But he does not like to pass the ball to his teammates. How will Yapo discover that winning is not only about scoring?
Ruby and her family have a fun day at the beach.
Crocodile, Tortoise, Penguin and Chicken find an egg. Is it their egg? ‘Our egg,’ say the proud Mum and Dad at the end. Discover whose egg it is.
Lesedi dreams of going to the beach. He wants to feel the sand between his toes and build a sandcastle. So his parents come up with a plan…
What are the most important things to take with you on a trip? Join Zuki, Tando, Mama and Papa on their eventful journey to find out.
Today is a very busy day. Come to town with Mama and me!
Is that your teacher? Is that your Aunty? Amanda is fed up with these questions and wishes that she looked just like her Mummy and Daddy. But maybe they are more alike than she realises!
Drought has struck Happy-Land, and Mama Birdie goes in search of the magic rain worm. Can anyone sing her back home?
Tendai Turtle’s Granny has hurt her shell and Mum and Dad have to go to help her. “Come stay with me,”says Tendai’s best friend Busi Bunny, and the fun begins.
Chapansi is worried about inswa when the new road is built. But the inswa have a plan.
Someone is in Mama Antelope’s House. Who could it be? All the animals try to open the door but only Baby Antelope knows how.
Teju is worried. Something keeps following him! What could it be?
Wiggle jiggle wriggle with the wiggly worm, on a fun adventure that is full of surprises.
When Gogo takes a nap, Khwezi and Mzamo decide to tidy up. What could possibly go wrong?
Hats off! Dudu and Dumisani have made up a new game. Ssh! Don’t tell Teacher.
Baby’s day is full of babble, whether she’s hungry, searching for her dummy, splashing in the bath or curled up in bed at night.
Mama loves to sing all day, especially to Baby.
Where is the baby?
Baby’s family is excited about their first family photo. What will Mama, Papa, Big Sister, Baby and Gogo wear?
Lerato’s world is made extra special by Mama and a colourful blankie. What is your special thing?
This cute little baby knows exactly what she wants. She wants to eat, she wants to play, and she wants to read a book with Mama!
Doggy wants to play, but Baby is scared.
Shh! Baby is asleep! Why is everyone making so much noise?
A new baby has come to play. Who could it be?

t: I don’t want to go to sleep!
s: Nandi doesn’t want to go to sleep. No way! She wants to go on an adventure. Join Nandi as she lets her imagination run wild and free.
This little lion wants you to know that lions are strong, fast, and most of all, brave. But what is that storm cloud on the horizon? A story about who we are and who we think we should be
The day of the concert is approaching, and Mihlali is getting more and more nervous. Will she ever be ready to dance in front of all those people?
Auntie Boi has sent a present from Kenya. Kopano and Rea go to town to pick it up. What a journey!
Who will win the Great Cake Contest? A sweet story about a little boy who wants to make the best cake.
Zoey loves finding things in the park. One day, she gets a big surprise.
Who says a rainy day can’t turn into an exciting day inside?
The lioness is tired. Her sisters and daughters want her to join the hunt. But the sun is calling her.
Mali likes to play alone. Gogo wants him to play with others. Mali tries, but he just does not enjoy himself. Until Lesedi comes along…
Amir loves Grandpa Farouk’s garden. But it’s dying. What can Amir do to help?
Have you ever heard of a fish that can’t swim?
Naledi is taking the train for the first time and wonders what kind of people she will see. The train is full of surprises!
Zandi has a friend that no one else can see. His name is Birdy Monster. They mix up magic potions, play pretend and go on adventures together.
Where is Lulu and why is she hiding?

Pirate, Tree and Bear are making it difficult to sleep. By day they are great friends, but when night comes, everything changes. No one can sleep. The Dream Pillow is a story about how to change bad dreams into good ones.
Hi! I’m fighting a monster, and I need you to help me. Yes, you!
Ann-Nem-Oh-Nee is stuck on her rock all alone. She’s looking for adventure and wants to see the world! But how?
Oh no, the naughty pumpkin pie thief is running away with Miss Sunflower’s pie! Will you help to catch the crook?
If the world is round, why don’t the people on the bottom fall off? Tig’s mom has one answer, and her dad has another. Who’s telling the truth?
The oakum boys go for a walk and discover strange new things: Lots of different penguins, one special friend, and a very big change. Growing up can be the biggest adventure of all!
Spotty the Hyena has lost his laugh. How did this happen? Where could it be? And can the other animals help him find it?
Black Dog is unhappy. He is lonely and everyone seems to be having more fun. So, he bounced … and bounced … and bounced …
Why do dragons always have to ruin everything? Now Lilly and Thinama need to chase down this troublesome reptile and restore the magical ruby to its rightful place.
Sometimes our feelings are hard to talk about, but everyone knows how to talk about the weather.

Mother Vulture takes Little Vulture on his first flight. On their journey, they see a dying gemsbok. She shows her son that the end of one animal’s life is also the beginning of a new cycle for other creatures.

A certain little girl is in the habit of saying ‘No’. She says it a lot. In fact, all of the time. One day though, she is faced with a very tempting question and can’t help but say ‘YES!’ Perhaps saying ‘Yes’ isn’t so bad after all.

t: That’s not Thabi, That’s a hippopotamus
s: Lucy can’t find her sister Thabi. But everywhere she looks there’s a suspicious hippopotamus. Does the hippo know where Thabi is?
It’s Rahah’s birthday party. Mum wants to know who she will invite. Will they all fit in?
Thabo’s make-believe world has no room for his little sister, Keitu. But she has other ideas!

Margaret was clever and curious. Margaret had big dreams. But 200 years ago a girl could not become a doctor. So she cut off her hair and she put on boy’s clothes. From then onwards, no one knew that Margaret was a girl. She became James Barry.
Lonwabo loves helping grandmother grow vegetables to make delicious meals for the family. He dreams of opening a restaurant one day and cooking just like his granny.
This book will help you understand your wonderful body and how babies are made. ** Parental guidance is advised.**
Mina finds it hard to choose a dress for her special day. After giving Mum a tough time, Mina finally makes a choice.
A child born with a full set of teeth? He surely is a miracle! Follow his adventure-filled story and find out where Mogau’s gifts take him.

Miss Tiny Chef is only eight years old. She does things other little girls wouldn’t do. Armed with a talking mingling stick that shares all its great recipes with her, Kasini stirs up a special surprise meal for mummy.
Nomvundla and Soko are off to the Chilli-Eating Contest. Animals come from far and wide to try to win the amazing prize. Who will win and get to take a friend to the Hamba-Hamba Funfair?

The morning sun creeps over the horizon and peeps through the leaves, waking Senzo. Gogo’s rooster shakes his wings, stretches his neck and crows, Koek-a-loek-a-loo! Join Senzo and the sun as they journey through the day.
Sam can’t wait for supper. What’s in the pot? Wait and see.
Foxy Joxy, a sly fox, sold watermelons. One day he had a clever idea. The animals were not happy. What will they do to teach him a lesson?
Thuli has the cookies. Special has her eye on the cookies. What’s their secret?
It’s Tumi’s first visit to the park. She’s so excited, there are many adventures. She might even make a new friend…
A story about my special hair. How special it can be. So many types of special hair. Just look around, you’ll see.
Have you ever wondered what goes doof-doof-doof in the night? A noisy bedtime story for a quiet night’s sleep.
Tone the raindrop is wondering what’s way down there on the ground. She and her friend Nyunyu go on a journey to find out.
Lolo has many lovely friends. They are Sun and Moon and Star and Bird too. She would love to introduce them to you.
There once lived a chicken, called Cikizwa, who was an orphan…
All the animals in the jungle are playing, except Lion. Why won’t Lion join in?
Lazy ant is very lazy. He lets the other ants do all the work. Will he ever stop being lazy?
There are numbers everywhere, but Zanele can’t see them.
Little Goat wanders off to look for the sweet grass and doesn’t realise how far she is from Mother Goat.
Pig loves to play! Clever Pig One day, Pig is gone. Will Pig come back?

t: Why is there a hole in the wall?
s: “Why is there a hole in the wall?” Lungisa asks. He gets lots of interesting answers…but he keeps on asking.

Prudence promises Micki and her friends that when they finish cleaning Micki’s room they can have biscuits. But when they are finished, Prudence is nowhere to be found. So Micki and her friends spend the rest of their day finding ways to reach the biscuit jar …
Born a twin that must be sacrificed, Mkabayi faces a bully and scary ghosts. Will the bond with her sister Mmama save her?
Small Bird loves the Giant. But where is the Giant? Small Bird goes on an adventure to find her.
Thabo’s family is getting ready for the day and making a big mess as they hurry to get things done. But where is Thabo?
“What if there’s a monster under my bed?” Tumi is scared. Mama tries to show him that everything is okay.

t: Unathi and the Dirty, Smelly Beast
s: Something is following Unathi…
One-year-old Palesa spends the night before her birthday wide-eyed with excitement. She can’t wait to find out what each of her friends will bring her. But what will be the biggest surprise of all?
I once had a dream, so small and light, I kept it in a box. I kept it hidden, safe and sound, in my drawer of socks.
On a very hot day, a child goes to the sea, where she discovers a game she can play with the waves.
This is Jilly. Today, she hugged most of the cats in town!
Every day, Katiiti’s mother calls her with a beautiful song. One day, a crafty gorilla tries to sing as sweetly as her mother.
Mom is going out for five minutes. What could go wrong?
What is it? It isn’t like me. Do you think it’s dangerous?
The Penguin family lives on the beach, surrounded by rubbish. Until one day, Mrs Penguin says: we need a house! But how will they build one?
Muzi loves to build with his toys. But when he leaves them behind to travel to uGogo’s house, he discovers something very special about the world. And he learns something new about himself.
A yellow bug in a world of red, Lara the Ladybird just wants to fit in.

t: Little Sock and the tiny creatures
s: It’s wash day for the Socks, but where has Little Sock gone?
Hippo wants to dance. Won’t anyone dance with her?
Rhino, Crocodile, Giraffe and Zebra all have an unlikely friend. Can you guess who he is?
I don’t know what I want to be when I grow up. Can you help me choose?
Lindi finds a very large elephant in her room. But is it really there if no one else believes in it?
Shongololo has lost his shoes, and the other animals are NOT being very helpful. Will he ever find them?
It is one week until Thato’s Birthday. His mama tells him he will have a big surprise. What will it be?
Nandi is wondering all sorts of strange things about the world. And it begins with a simple question: What if…?
Sbu’s little brother finds Sbu’s favourite shoes. When he tries them on, he discovers something very special about them.
Sima wants to be a nurse one day. His favourite game is hospital-hospital. But papa and his friends do not approve. What will change their minds?
In this delightful tale of hope, Jabulile’s dream of helping people comes true after a terrible storm hits the Valley.
Sindi buzzes with colourful songs and dance. Will starting school end all that?
It’s a beautiful day for a picnic. Everyone wants to join in the fun.
When Mama Heron needs help, Lungile comes to her rescue.
Londi loves to dream all day. But where will her dreams take her?

t: Searching for the Spirit of Spring
s: Nkanyezi can’t wait for the Spring festival, but the people of Ndlovu have lost their spirit of celebration. She must go in search of the spirit of Spring. What will she find?
Tinny Tim sets out on an adventure to return a lost button. Along the way he goes exploring, has a miraculous escape, and makes new friends.
Nita’s hanging upside down. Can she turn the right way round?
Rafiki’s style is all his own, but when the Cool Cat Crew struts by, he starts to wonder if it’s good enough.
The children are talking about their grandpas. Giraffe’s grandpa can build a skyscraper. Elephant’s grandpa can cook a massive feast. But whose grandpa will give the children the biggest surprise?
Little Karabo watches all the grown-ups in her family, and wonders, ‘What do I do? What do I know?’
A walk to the clinic doesn’t have to be dull, when there are so many wonderful things to see on the way.
I wonder if there’s another me somewhere in the world…
You don’t need to be alike to be friends. When two very different children meet an unusual creature, it’s a chance to ask, How About You?
On a little farm lives Daisy, a little chicken who wishes she could fly. All the other chickens laugh at her daily flying practice. But one day something amazing happens …
This is a story about a little ant with a big plan, and how his love for reading saved the day.
Lory Dory was born invisible. No one understands that she is real. Until, one day, she finds a way to show them who she is.
In a village on the slopes of Mount Kenya, a little girl worked in the fields with her mother. She worried as she saw the big forests disappearing, but she knew the power of a tiny seed.
Jack’s bath time takes a wild turn as things in his bathtub start to change, and a group of animals becomes part of his adventurous bathtub safari!
Tortoise sets off in search of his house. Along the way, he meets new friends to help him. But the sky is darkening, and lightning flashes in the distance. Will Tortoise find his house in time?
This is the story of Helen Martins’ battle against darkness, told by one of the creatures she loved best, the wise old owl.
Phyllis Spira was dancing by the age of four. That was just the beginning of her journey towards becoming one of South Africa’s Prima Ballerinas.

As a young girl Zanele Situ was told that she would never walk again. Being in a wheelchair did not stop her. She worked and trained hard and became a winning athlete on the world stage. This is her story…
Learn about the amazing life of a little girl who grew up to use her gift of singing to help bring freedom to South Africa.

There once was a girl named Sindiwe Magona. She had a special gift for stories. At night, little Sindiwe’s grandmother told her magical stories about ogres and giants, animals of the forests and the little creatures of the veld. This was Sindiwe’s favourite time. See how she grows up to live out her own adventures and she travels over oceans to change the world with her stories.

Basetsana Kumalo is a beauty queen, but she’s also so much more. She teaches us that true beauty is about having a heart filled with love and generosity. Her story shows us that if you have courage and determination, you can achieve your dreams – whatever they may be.
The inspiring story of Graça Machel, and her dream to instill a love for reading and learning in the children of Mozambique and the rest of Africa.

From the day she was born to the day she died, Albertina Sisulu lived a life of love and sacrifice. A brave girl who rode a horse, she was a blessing to her family, to her community and to South Africa. This story of a unique and powerful woman, who stood up for her beliefs no matter what, will inspire and enchant.
Today Sizwe learns that a smile is something you can give away without losing it.
Mouse is looking for a new house. Friendly animals offer to share their homes with him. But nothing is right until he finds his own little spot, warm and cosy.
It’s Maddy Moona’s birthday and she really wants a pet! But which silly animal will picky Maddy get?
Yusuf waits on the beach while Papa pushes out his boat. Surfers, turtles and sharks come from the sea. What will Papa bring back for Yusuf?
A delightful tale about an independent cat.
He’s quite good at climbing. He knows how to swing. But sleeping’s his favourite, favourite thing!
